# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_7.csv", index_col=0)
source8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_8.csv", index_col=0)
source9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_30/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# Step 1: Union the four sources with the same schema (source3, source4, source5, source7)
union_3_4_5_7 = pd.concat([source3, source4, source5, source7], ignore_index=True)

# Step 2: Join source0 with source6 on ROW_WID
join_0_6 = pd.merge(source0, source6, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 3: Join source8 with source9 on ROW_WID
join_8_9 = pd.merge(source8, source9, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 4: Join join_0_6 with join_8_9 on ROW_WID
join_0_6_8_9 = pd.merge(join_0_6, join_8_9, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 5: Join union_3_4_5_7 with source0 on ROW_WID
# But source0 is already joined with source6 and others, so join union with source0 first
# Actually, the operation history shows the first joins are union then join with source0,1,2
# So we need to join union_3_4_5_7 with source0, source1, source2 on ROW_WID

# Join union_3_4_5_7 with source0 on ROW_WID
union_with_0 = pd.merge(union_3_4_5_7, source0, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join the above with source1 on ROW_WID
union_with_0_1 = pd.merge(union_with_0, source1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join the above with source2 on ROW_WID
union_with_0_1_2 = pd.merge(union_with_0_1, source2, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Now join union_with_0_1_2 with join_0_6_8_9 on ROW_WID to combine all
# But join_0_6_8_9 already contains source0,6,8,9
# union_with_0_1_2 contains union_3_4_5_7, source0,1,2
# source0 is duplicated in both, so join on ROW_WID to combine all columns

final_join = pd.merge(union_with_0_1_2, join_0_6_8_9, on="ROW_WID", how="inner", suffixes=('_left', '_right'))

# The final target schema is ['ARPU': float]
# ARPU is present in union_3_4_5_7 (and thus in union_with_0_1_2) and also in union_3_4_5_7 part of final_join (left side)
# We take ARPU from the left side (union_with_0_1_2) which is the unioned ARPU column

# Extract ARPU column and convert to float
Target9_30 = final_join[['ARPU']].copy()
Target9_30['ARPU'] = Target9_30['ARPU'].astype(float)

# Save the result to the specified path
Target9_30.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_30/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
